results.name: the target app (Text Editor) is up and placeable
the panel shortcut opens the panel for the focused window
dragging across the grid places the window exactly

results.name: the panel closes after placing and focus returns to the window
Esc closes the panel without moving the window and focus returns to it
Alt+= / Alt+Shift+= add a column / row, and the size is kept the next time the panel opens
Shift+drag places the window and keeps the panel open
holding Alt subdivides 10x10 to 20x20 and a half-cell selection lands exactly
panel-local shortcut (Ctrl+Left) snaps while the panel is open and does nothing once it is closed
with reset on open, a grid changed with Alt+= is back to the default 6x6 next time
when the target closes with the panel open, the panel stays (with a notice), a drag places nothing and no other window moves

results.name: starting Fractile again from the app menu opens the panel for the focused window
no Python errors in the UI's output
with the tray icon on, Fractile's icon is registered in the desktop's tray (StatusNotifierWatcher) and active
a left click on the tray icon (StatusNotifierItem.Activate, what the tray sends) shows the panel for the focused window
Settings opens from the service request with all eight pages
every page renders (screenshots in tests/evidence/gui/)
a General change is only pending until Apply, then the service has it
a global shortcut without a modifier is refused and the editor keeps listening
